patches_modified.name: Add ability to copy media link
patches_modified.description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.

patches_modified.name: Custom download folder
patches_modified.description: Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.

patches_modified.name: Custom share menu
patches_modified.description: Hides options from the post menu.

patches_modified.name: Custom sharing domain
patches_modified.description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.

patches_modified.name: Customize Inline action Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.

patches_modified.name: Customize Navigation Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize default reply sorting
patches_modified.description: Sets the sort replies open with.

patches_modified.name: Customize explore tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.

patches_modified.name: Customize notification tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.

patches_modified.name: Customize search tab items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize side bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides rows from the side bar.

patches_modified.name: Customize timeline top bar
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Delete from database
patches_modified.description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
patches_modified.description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.

patches_modified.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches_modified.description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.

patches_modified.name: Enable debug menu for posts
patches_modified.description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.

patches_modified.name: Enable force HD videos
patches_modified.description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Filter posts by keyword
patches_modified.description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Force enable translate
patches_modified.description: Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.

patches_modified.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches_modified.description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.

patches_modified.name: Hide Community Notes
patches_modified.description: Hides Community Notes under posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide FAB
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating Post button.

patches_modified.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide promote button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.

patches_modified.name: Hook feature flag
patches_modified.description: Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.

patches_modified.name: Import/Export login token
patches_modified.description: Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.

patches_modified.name: Legacy share links
patches_modified.description: Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.

patches_modified.name: Native downloader
patches_modified.description: Lets every photo, video and GIF be saved from its long-press menu and the media viewer, without a watermark.

patches_modified.name: Native reader mode
patches_modified.description: Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.

patches_modified.name: Native translator
patches_modified.description: Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.

patches_modified.name: No shortened URL
patches_modified.description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.

patches_modified.name: Remove premium upsell
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium upsells: the Upgrade button on the home timeline, the Premium side bar row, and the Get verified cards and prompts.

patches_modified.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches_modified.description: Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.

patches_modified.name: Show poll results
patches_modified.description: Shows the results of polls without voting. Polls cannot be voted on while this is applied.

patches_modified.name: Show sensitive media
patches_modified.description: Shows media marked sensitive without blurring it behind a warning.

patches_modified.name: Support external downloader
patches_modified.description: Adds "Open in downloader" to the post menu, which shares the post's link with an app of your choice.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium checks
patches_modified.description: Makes the app's own Premium subscription checks always pass. Features the server enforces still need a subscription.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria lifecycle, aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, stubs Singular attribution SDK initializers and dispatchers, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), rewrites default telemetry endpoints inside telemetry packages and custom blocked hosts unscoped to 0.0.0.0, disables cross-sell, Floodgate, HockeyApp and DataTransport components, and strips advertising and preinstall attribution permissions.
patches_modified.previous_description: Neutralizes Microsoft OneDS/Aria lifecycle, aggregated-metric and failure-logging dispatch methods, nullifies ad measurement platform identifiers (AIFA, AppSetId), rewrites default telemetry endpoints inside telemetry packages and custom blocked hosts unscoped to 0.0.0.0, disables cross-sell, Floodgate, HockeyApp and DataTransport components, and strips advertising permissions.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Code Transparency
patches_modified.description: Skips the code-transparency failure dialog and reports local verification success, unblocking sideloaded installs.

patches_modified.name: Copilot Companion Native Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips optional companion native binaries (React Native, Hermes, SlimCV) via in-situ zeroing. WARNING: Hermes and React Native are load-bearing for React Native initialization - enabling this WILL crash Copilot React Native surfaces (Copilot chat host) with UnsatisfiedLinkError. The HockeyApp native exception handler (proven UnsatisfiedLinkError in OfficeApplication.onMAMCreate) and voice/dictation SDKs (libofficevoicesdk, libofficevoicetranscriptionsdk; proven dlopen FATAL on boot path) are load-bearing at startup and are therefore never stripped.

patches_modified.name: Disable Login Requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes login requirement and FTUX paywall screens. Cloud-backed features still require sign-in server-side.

patches_modified.name: Ambient light
patches_modified.description: Fills the black bars around the video with a soft glow of the picture's colours, like Ambient light for YouTube. Configurable in Settings > Video and audio > Ambient light.

patches_modified.name: Danmaku comments
patches_modified.description: Flows regular comments, live chat, and chat replays over videos like NicoNico/bilibili, with native in-app settings, NG words, and no API key.

patches_modified.name: Auto-translate Reddit content
patches_modified.description: Automatically invokes Reddit's existing post and comment translation path.

patches_added.name: Auto claim mission rewards
patches_added.description: Claims completed My missions rewards and draws their lotteries in the background, without the reward popup or the lottery animation, and shows a short message with the result.
